activity_summary: Alse brought water and you sent her off the paper. You called the blot a blot and said you were well. Mistress Ansell left broth as dinner and did not send you out. Gib was asleep on the Golding. Alse asked about the year and a day, which she had already heard through the floor. You told her they do not marry, and you did not fill the messenger's half-line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to have the paper touched, said he was well, and left the half-line empty.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the water, named the blot, asked about the year and a day, and kept off the lines.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Spoke from the stair, set broth as dinner, and did not come up.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Asleep on the Golding. No lines.
